name: CompTIA Security+ V8
status: published-objectives; exam launch date not verified

objectives.description: Explain security concepts and controls.
Given a scenario, demonstrate the impact of change management processes on security.
Explain the importance of using appropriate cryptographic solutions.
Explain characteristics of threats and vulnerabilities.
Describe common threat actors and motivations.
Describe threat vectors and sources.

subtopics.text: Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart(CAPTCHA)

objectives.description: Explain types of vulnerabilities and attack surfaces.
Given a scenario, analyze indicators of malicious activity.
Summarize threats and vulnerabilities associated with artificial intelligence (AI) usage.
Compare and contrast security implications of different architecture models.
Given a scenario, manage the security architecture to best protect the infrastructure.
Summarize concepts and strategies used to protect data.
Explain the importance of resilience and recovery in security architecture.
Given a scenario, apply mitigating controls, techniques, and solutions to secure the environment.

subtopics.text: Network-based intrusion detection system (NIDS)/Network-based intrusion prevention system (NIPS)
Host-based intrusion detection system (HIDS)/Host-based Intrusion prevention system (HIPS)
Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting, and Conformance (DMARC)

objectives.description: Explain the security implications of proper hardware, software, and data asset management.
Given a scenario, perform tasks associated with vulnerability management.
Explain security alerting and monitoring concepts and tools.
Given a scenario, apply concepts related to identity and access management.
Given a scenario, apply automation and orchestration solutions to secure operations.

subtopics.text: Use cases of automation and scripting

objectives.description: Summarize concepts associated with incident response activities.
Given a scenario, use data, artifacts and sources to support a security investigation.
Explain the importance of governance, risk, and compliance artifacts.
Explain the impact of risk management processes on the security of the organization.
Explain the assessment and management processes associated with third- party risk.
Summarize elements of effective security compliance.
Explain concepts associated with audit and assessment activities.
Given a scenario, apply security awareness concepts to improve organizational security.
